english: There it is! Every time, but it's just an instant.
Wow, this isn't Kyouto!\nI thought we'd go back, but\nit's somewhere else!
It feels similar to my world,\nbut also not.
Maybe similar to the world me and Aoi-chan were in?\nCan't tell if it's the same, though.
Um... this building looks familiar.
It's Butei High!\nThe school Aria-san goes to!
Aria's?
Umm, Aria's school!\nA name like... 'Beauty High'...?
Um, I think it's Butei High...
Right right! That's it! That!!
You know this place?\nThen we can relax a little.
I have some bad memories of it, though...
Huh... you all are...?
Hauuu, Shirayuki-san! Long time no see!
Ahaha... long time no see, Shirayuki-san.
...I see.\nThe mystery still isn't solved.
We still don't know the cause.\nSo we split into 3 groups...
Aria-san's in another group,\nso she probably didn't\ncome to this world.
Aria's in another group,\nso she probably went somewhere else.
Ah, but don't worry!\nAria-chan was super energetic!
Yes, Aria will be fine\nwherever she goes.
Rather, it's this side that's...
This side?
No, it's nothing.
Hm? Something troubling you?
Butei High always\nhas troubles,\nso don't worry about it.
The room you used before\nis still kept ready,\nso please use it freely.
That helps!\nWe didn't really have\nanywhere to go.
Thanks! Super helpful!\nSomehow... Shirayuki-san, you seem\nused to this stuff!
Hmm, so this is the room you got to use.
...I didn't so much 'use' it as...\nI was kept under Aria-san's watch\nhere the whole time.
A warrior needs half a mat to sit and one mat to sleep.\nThere should be a shower, and if it's free I can't complain...\nwait, huh?
No way you were sleeping in this same room\ntoo, were you!?
S-s-sorry,\nI was sleeping here too...
Shameless! Sit right there!\n'At seven, boys and girls don't share a bed' — that's common sense!
Uuuuh,\neven if you tell ME that...!
Huh? Whatcha doing?\nSparring?
No!
Forget that, it's terrible, Houki-chan!
What happened?
Shirayuki-chan's being targeted by a kidnapper demon!
Kidnapping?
There's a kidnapper called the Demon Sword (Durandal)\nthat only targets Chou-tei, apparently.
Oh, Chou-tei are Butei who use psychic powers,\nand Shirayuki-san's special even among them.
If she's targeted\nby this Demon Sword (Durandal),\nwhy was Shirayuki out walking alone?
Umm, I don't really get it, but...\nmaybe the Demon Sword (Durandal)\ndoesn't really exist.
Doesn't exist?\nLike a school ghost story or urban legend?
Nobody's ever seen it, apparently.\nDoes it exist or not — mystery.
So the rumor that Shirayuki's targeted\nis spreading with no basis at all.\nIs that what you're saying?
Shirayuki-chan\nwas probably brooding over that.
Hey, can't we do something\nfor Shirayuki-chan?
Even so, we're outsiders.\nIf we act carelessly\nand complicate things, that'd be bad.
Anyway, was it okay to just wander the school\nasking around!?
Don't be so stiff!
Last time too, Aria-san sent me to buy\n'momoman' and stuff —\ncoming and going was pretty free.
'Free,' or... I had to go\nor it'd be instant 'ventilation'...
Right, this is a school where all students are armed.\nNo need for monitoring — as if it didn't exist.
Thinking about it, 'kidnapping Shirayuki'\nsounds like a silly story,\neven so.
There's nowhere safer than here.
Nowhere scarier,\neither...
But the dorms are off-campus.\nCommuting could be a bit dangerous.
Are the dorms on campus?
Um, I believe...\nthey're off-campus.
Then let's go see her\non her way home!
Ah, there she is!\nHey, Shirayuki-chaan!
Oh, Haruka-san.\nAnd everyone.
Huh, you wear shrine maiden clothes?\nSuits you!
Going home in that outfit — did something happen?
No, after afternoon training,\nI was heading back to change.\nAnyway, what's up? Going out?
No.\nWe just heard the Demon Sword (Durandal) rumor,\nand it got me worried...
Ah... it's reached\nyour ears too.
What do you think of the rumor, Shirayuki-san?
Well... I think the rumors have gotten\na bit too big. There's no way\nsomeone like me would be targeted.
But I heard Shirayuki-chan's special?
That's probably because I'm student council president.
The academic affairs teacher says to get a bodyguard...\noverprotective, right?
Bodyguard?
Yes, since going alone is dangerous.\nI don't think the Demon Sword (Durandal)\nreally exists, though...
That's it! I got an idea!
Huh?
We'll be Shirayuki-chan's\nbodyguards!
All of you?
Haruka... what are you starting now...!
Listen, Houki-chan! I got an idea!
Hey! Too close!
Listen, Shirayuki-chan.\nThis world might have someones from other worlds\nlike us, right?
Bad-looking folks came too, right?
That's right...\nthere's someone super dangerous.\nDoctor Shinigami...
So the one targeting Shirayuki-chan\nmight be a bad guy from another world!
Hmm... so it wasn't\njust a random thought.
If so, it might not be\nunrelated to us either.
Then that means...\nit's our turn?
Uh, wh-what's wrong?\nScary face...?
Careful! Hostility... approaching!
What!?
Enemies everywhere\nbefore we knew it!
Shirayuki-san's popular!\nMaybe not the fun kind of popular, though.
I'll go call Red Angel!
Hurry, Haruka!\nKoto, guard Shirayuki!
You got it!
I appreciate the concern,\nbut don't worry.
Hm?
I can protect myself too.
Haha, as expected of a Butei!
Mm, no openings...!\nShe's highly trained...
Hoshiga Shirayuki, going in!!
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone!
Alright, let's do this!!
What's the enemy after?
Dunno? Shirayuki-san\nor us — which?
Could be both.
Haha, simple enough!
We just beat 'em all!
I'll take point! Everyone else...
Ah, none of that!\nWe're all strong!
Except for about one person.
Sorry, sorry...\nI'll try not to drag you down...\nI'll be careful...
Wh-who's that?
...I wonder?
Look! What's in her hand!
That's the demon sword!?\nThen you're the Demon Sword (Durandal)!
You won't lay a finger\non Shirayuki-chan!
Wait, from the name, shouldn't the Demon Sword (Durandal)\nbe a Western blade?
Huh...?
That's less a sword and more a hatchet.
Aren't swords and hatchets pretty much the same?
No! Totally different!
Well, it sure doesn't feel\nlike a Durandal.
Honestly... the sword is a warrior's soul.
...Are we done chatting?
Whoa, here she comes!
Roger!
Shirayuki-chan, be careful too.
Yes!
Did we get her...?
Ah, she ran...
What was that... creepy person...
Phew...
Um... is something...?
No,\nI just thought you fought quite normally.
Huh...
I'd heard Chou-tei use psychic powers,\nbut you fought without them — that caught my eye.
My power isn't much.\nThere's no way the Demon Sword (Durandal)\nwould target me.
Is that so?
Yes...
...Then, was that creep's target\nus?
Shirayuki-san, while we were gone,\ndid things like that show up?
After Aria-san and the others vanished from this world,\ndid things like that appear?
No, not as far as I know.
So we were the targets after all...
That would\nmake more sense.
Shirayuki-chan?
There's no way I'd be targeted.\nSo please, don't worry\nabout me.
The rumors and the academic office teachers\nare all exaggerating.
I'm fine on my own.
But just in case, a bodyguard...
No.\nI appreciate the thought, but\nI refuse.
What! Why!?
I'm Hoshiga Shirayuki.\nA shrine maiden of Hoshiga Shrine,\nwith over two thousand years of history.
Normally, I'm not even allowed to leave the shrine grounds...\nI'm ordained to avoid contact\nwith people and the outside world as much as possible.
Huh...
Even entering Butei High\nwas barely permitted,\nwith many restrictions.
Not leaving Butei High's grounds without permission,\nnot appearing before crowds.\nAnd...
I know it myself.\nIt's better not to get deeply involved with people.
...That's not okay!!
Huh?
Saying you want to be alone...\nanyone would be lonely!!
Haruka-san? What's gotten into you?
I'll be Shirayuki-chan's friend!\nOkay? Don't say things like that.
Your feelings alone are enough.\nAs a shrine maiden of Hoshiga Shrine,\nI can't break the taboo.
Shirayuki-chan...!
Excuse me.
Haruka-san...\ndon't be so down.
Hearts don't always connect.\nSometimes they just don't.\nInstant combos never work out, y'know?
Good grief, Haruka has\nno restraint with people.
Mm... th-that is!\nI'm not saying Haruka's wrong!
We're outsiders to this world.\nEven trying to get deeply involved,\nthere are limits, right?
Yeah, but still...!
Haruka-san, why are you so desperate?\nYou're surprising me.
Being alone... hurts.\nI know, because I was alone too.
Haruka...
But... I had Aoi-chan...
No matter how much I pushed her away,\nAoi-chan never gave up calling out to me...\nShe caught my heart.
I don't know if I can do it\nlike Aoi-chan.\nBut I don't want to give up...
Even if they call me nosy,\neven if they call me a bother,\nI'll be Shirayuki-chan's friend!
Haruka... you really are...
Huh, nice!\nThat's so Haruka-san!
Ehehe, sorry.
No need to apologize.\n(When she uses that voice... I can't help\nremembering my sister... mm...)
Either way, we must find out whether this\nDemon Sword (Durandal) really exists and what it is.\nWe don't know if it's unrelated to us yet.
Speaking of, Hoshiga Shrine, was it?\nIf it's that amazing a shrine,\nmaybe we should go pray there!
'I wish I become friends\nwith Shirayuki-san!' — like that!
And also,\nmay I meet delicious food!\nMay I discover legendary delicacies!
And defeat! The Demon Sword (Durandal),\ndon't let me get a stomachache from overeating,\nand, and...!
Too many wishes!
Ahaha, so Koto-chan!
Hehe!
One after another...\nhow much offering money do you plan to throw!
Any god swayed by the amount of offering money is a fake!
Ahaha! Koto-chan!
Well, we shouldn't\ntake our eyes off Shirayuki.
But Haruka, don't rush too much.\nYou don't want to be hated, right?
Yeah. I know it won't be easy\nand it'll take time.
Well, for now, let's do lunch time!
It's always food with you...
//END
